name: caldo
description: Dev-only browser QA tooling for Caldo.

scripts.test:e2e:visual: npm run test:e2e && node tests/e2e/visual-review.js --browser chromium
scripts.test:e2e:firefox:title: CALDO_E2E_TITLE_ONLY=1 playwright test tests/e2e/bulk-selection.spec.js tests/e2e/focus-refresh-dirty-race.spec.js tests/e2e/inline-title-caret.spec.js tests/e2e/mvp-flow.spec.js --project=firefox
scripts.test:e2e:visual:webkit: npm run test:e2e:webkit && node tests/e2e/visual-review.js --browser webkit
scripts.test:e2e:ci: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:webkit
